title: 校园活动词汇
goal: 理解校园活动词汇，并依据场景表达确定活动安排。

points.label: 识别校园活动词汇的语境义
依据场景词听出活动安排

sources.title: 高考英语（新课标卷）：课表
sources.used: 校园词汇范围与课程小测规格

body.p: 本课的校园活动词汇分四类：课程作业、社团报名、图书借阅和体育活动。一个词的具体意思，要看搭配和场景。

body.box: Please renew the book before its due date.

body.p: renew the book 表示续借图书。due date 是应还日期。

cards.title: 词汇表：课程作业
rows: The class must meet the deadline for the report.
Mia completed her assignment before lunch.
Please submit the report on Friday.
Leo is writing an essay about trees.
The first draft is on the desk.
Ana will revise her draft tonight.
We attended a lecture on local history.
Sam is taking a course in photography.
The students received their grades yesterday.
The teacher gave feedback on each report.

cards.title: 词汇表：社团报名
rows: 报名；sign up for a club
Nina signed up for the art club.
Ben joined the music club in May.
Each club member has a card.
登记报名；register for an event
Students can register for the event online.
Please submit an application by Monday.
The members attended a meeting after class.
The event organizer reserved the room.
A student volunteer welcomed the guests.
Check the schedule for the next rehearsal.
The choir will attend a rehearsal on Tuesday.

cards.title: 词汇表：图书借阅
rows: I borrowed a book from the library.
Kai renewed the book for another week.
Please return the book by Friday.
应还日期；check the due date
Check the due date inside the book.
Show a library card at the desk.
The dictionary is on the top shelf.
Ask a librarian about the collection.
We searched the catalogue for the title.
Mina reserved a book for her project.
The librarian extended the loan by a week.

cards.title: 词汇表：体育活动
rows: The team coach changed the schedule.
The team will play a match on Sunday.
The tennis court is beside the hall.
The running track is open after class.
The coach checked the sports equipment.
The players did a warm-up before practice.
Our team entered the school tournament.
The team captain spoke to the coach.

items.stem: The deadline for the essay is Friday. What is Friday?
options: The first day of the course
The day the essay was returned
The day the teacher gave feedback
items.why: deadline 指提交作业的截止日期。

items.stem: Nora signed up for the choir. What did she do?
items.why: signed up for 表示报名参加。

items.stem: The librarian renewed the loan. What changed?
options: The book was replaced with a new copy.
The loan was ended that day.
items.why: renewed the loan 表示延长借阅期限。

items.stem: The team will attend practice. What will they attend?
options: A meeting to discuss the match
A talk on the team schedule
A training session for the team
items.why: 体育语境中的 practice 指训练。

items.stem: Mia submitted her assignment. What did she do?
items.why: submitted her assignment 表示提交作业。

items.stem: A volunteer welcomed the guests. Who welcomed them?
options: A member invited as a guest
A person paid to organize the event
items.why: volunteer 指志愿提供帮助的人。

lines.text: When is the deadline for the history assignment? I have a draft, but I need another evening to revise it before submitting.
The teacher moved the deadline to Friday, so you have until then.

items.why: moved the deadline to Friday 表示截止日期改为周五。

lines.text: I'd like to join the photography club. Can I register at the meeting tomorrow, or should I send the form before then?
Send the form today. The meeting is for registered members.

items.stem: What should the student do today?
options: Ask the members for a form
items.why: Send the form today 是当天要做的事。会议只对已登记的成员开放，所以不能到会上再报名。

items.stem: The report deadline is Monday. What does deadline mean?
options: The time the report is assigned
items.why: deadline 表示提交的截止时间。

items.stem: Students can sign up for the club today. What can they do?
items.why: sign up for 表示报名参加。

items.stem: The reader wants to renew a book. What does the reader want?
options: To get a new copy of the book
To borrow the book for the first time
items.why: renew a book 表示续借，延长借阅期限。

items.stem: The team has practice after class. What is planned?
items.why: team practice 指队伍的训练活动。

items.stem: The teacher gave feedback on the draft. What was given?
options: A topic for the first draft
items.why: feedback 指对草稿的反馈意见。

items.stem: The team captain spoke to the coach. Who is the captain?

lines.text: I'd like to sign up for the drama club. The notice says the meeting is on Thursday, but I haven't sent my registration form yet.
Please send it by Tuesday. The meeting is for registered students.

items.stem: When must the form be sent?
items.why: send it by Tuesday 说明报名表的提交期限。

options: Students will register at the meeting.
The club notice will be written.
The drama club will hold a meeting.
items.why: the meeting is on Thursday 说明周四举行社团会议。

lines.text: I borrowed a book for my science assignment, but it's due tomorrow. Can I keep it until next Friday to finish the report?
Yes. I'll renew the loan until next Friday. Please bring your library card to the desk.

options: Extend the loan until next Friday
Keep the library card at the desk
Lend another book for the assignment
items.why: I'll renew the loan until next Friday 表示把借阅期延长到下周五，即第一项。
bring your library card to the desk 指明须带借书证。
